limitations: Self user event samples, not inclusive caller stacks, elapsed time or kernel cost.
Non-user PCs from a user event remain unattributed in the full denominator; they do not measure kernel cost.
Function estimates require separate stat medians; multiplying sample share is a cross-run estimate.
Input sections can contain inlined callees; symbol overlaps and aliases remain explicit.
Zero-size functions, gaps and unknown images remain unattributed; no nearest-symbol guesses.

estimate_formula: sample period / all sample period * median(NEW same-side/transport independent stat user cycles / 5000 completed operations); cross-run estimate, not counted function cycles
limitations: Historical E measurements are not pooled or substituted.
One sample per side/transport identifies candidate hotspots, not stable function precision or causality.
Unknown/non-user/overlap periods remain in the full denominator.
Counter/scaling details and complete three-window ranges are retained.
IPC is computed from matching counters in each stat window.
